name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
source:
Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books...

Until her eyes fell out.

You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression.

There's just one problem.

She isn't depressed.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5023750/BASIC_PARADE_or_you_should_be_depressed/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
社交能力欠缺的莉萨一向在书本中寻求慰藉……

直到她的眼珠掉了出来。

你将扮演亨利，受指派负责引导莉萨走出抑郁阴霾的心理治疗师。

然而眼下只有一个问题：

她压根就没有抑郁。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5023750/BASIC_PARADE_or_you_should_be_depressed/]Steam[/url]]
